tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: The substance used in the thermite process of reducing metal ores is

solution.text: A mixture of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Al</mi></math> powder and metallic oxide <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>Cr</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msub><mi>Mn</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>4</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi>etc</mi><mo>)</mo></math> is called thermite.
